image_asset.title: Square Dot Arrays & L-Shaped Gnomon Decomposition

hotspots.label: Central Tile (n=1)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: First odd number term = 1. Forms a 1x1 square.

hotspots.label: Second Gnomon Layer (+3)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Second layer contains 3 dots. Total sum 1+3 = 4 (2x2 square).

hotspots.label: Third Gnomon Layer (+5)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Third layer contains 5 dots. Total sum 1+3+5 = 9 (3x3 square).

hotspots.label: Acute Angle (0° < θ < 90°)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Angle rotation less than a quarter turn (90°).

hotspots.label: Right Angle (θ = 90°)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Exact quarter turn rotation. Perpendicular rays.

hotspots.label: Obtuse Angle (90° < θ < 180°)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Between quarter turn (90°) and half turn (180°).

hotspots.label: Straight Angle (θ = 180°)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Exact half turn rotation. Forms a straight line.

hotspots.label: Reflex Angle (180° < θ < 360°)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Greater than half turn but less than full turn.

hotspots.label: Reverse-and-Add Palindrome Algorithm
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Adds a number to its digit reverse iteratively (e.g. 57+75=132 -> 132+231=363).

hotspots.label: Collatz Conjecture Trajectory
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Applies n/2 for evens and 3n+1 for odds, always decaying to 1.

image_asset.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes Prime Number Grid

hotspots.label: Special Case: Number 1
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 1 has only 1 factor. It is neither prime nor composite.

hotspots.label: Smallest Prime: Number 2
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 2 is the only even prime number. All higher multiples of 2 are composite.

hotspots.label: Primes 1 to 100
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: There are exactly 25 prime numbers between 1 and 100.

image_asset.title: Perimeter Boundary vs Enclosed Surface Area

hotspots.label: Perimeter (1D Boundary Length)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Outer boundary distance measured in linear units (cm, m). Formula = 2(l+w).

hotspots.label: Area (2D Surface Region)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Enclosed surface region measured in square units (sq cm, sq m). Formula = l x w.

hotspots.label: Whole Unit (1)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: The complete single whole reference bar.

hotspots.label: Halves (1/2)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Whole divided into 2 equal parts. Each part = 1/2.

hotspots.label: Quarters (1/4)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Two 1/4 parts equal one 1/2 part. Equivalent fractions: 2/4 = 1/2.
